title: Meta
description: What a chart type says about itself: a family's `pub static META: Meta` for that type, serialised (REQ-CHART-010, REQ-CHART-020). Listed in the module function `charts_json()` and in web/pkg/modules.js's `charts`, and read by the contract test, the site and the CLI's `list`. Every field is always present.

slug.description: The chart type: the element's `type`, the CLI's `<type>`, kebab-case and unique among types, e.g. "candles". Never `render`, `demo` or `list` (REQ-REG-020).

note.description: One lowercase line saying what the chart shows, 1 to 72 characters.

family.description: The family that plays the type, which is its Cargo feature and its wasm module in a release build: line, candles, bar, scatter, heatmap, sky in the first tier.

modes.description: The modes the `mode` option may name (REQ-CHART-030), the default first.

shapes.description: The data shapes the chart accepts (discovery/data.md, Domain shapes); data of another shape is an error naming these (REQ-DATA-110).

options.description: The defaults of every option the chart reads (REQ-OPT-010), as a JSON object, or null for a chart that reads none. Unlike unicel's Meta, which carried options as the text of a JSON object, glyphplot carries the object itself.

min.description: The smallest grid at which the chart draws with its axes (REQ-LAYOUT-070); below it the chart sheds parts in the order of `drop`. The contract draws at this size.

drop.description: The parts the chart sheds below `min`, first shed first. A part not listed is kept at every size the layout rules allow (REQ-LAYOUT-020).

mono.description: How the chart looks in one ink: "auto", its colour frame without the colours; "authored", drawn for one ink on purpose (dash patterns, markers, fills; REQ-MONO-010 to REQ-MONO-030).

charset.description: Which glyphs the chart may draw outside label text (REQ-CHAR-010): basic (ASCII, a few symbols, box drawing, blocks), extended (plus arrows, geometric shapes, braille, octants, legacy computing), wide (any scalar, double-width glyphs in two cells).

budget.description: What the chart may cost, the family default unless the chart says otherwise; the manifest writes it as its module's budget (ROADMAP §12).
